title: Decimal-scale mismatch in NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.onDispatch under-mints phUSD mint-debt by ~1e12x (silent no-op)
description: NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.onDispatch computes the phUSD mint-debt as (amount * ratio) / 100, copied verbatim from the 18-decimal USDS sibling BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook. On NudgeRatchet the dispatch token is USDC, which is deploy-guarded to 6 decimals (NudgeRatchet.sol:38), while phUSD is 18 decimals. The formula performs no 1e12 normalization between the 6-dp input amount and the 18-dp mint-debt output, so the mint-debt is under-minted by ~1e12x. Across the realistic operating range the resulting debt rounds to zero, so the no-op guard at line 115 short-circuits and the mint-debt accounting feature is a silent total no-op. This is a Law-1 faithful-but-unsafe-story case: the code faithfully mirrors the USDS sibling, but applied to a 6-dp token the intended story-035 behaviour (accrue phUSD mint-debt proportional to dispatched value) is not achieved. Merged from econ-scanner ECON-035-01 and story-faithfulness F-02.
impact: Total failure of the NudgeRatchet phUSD mint-debt accounting feature: dispatched USDC accrues effectively zero phUSD mint-debt (~1e12x under-mint, rounding to a no-op across realistic amounts). Direction is UNDER-mint, which fails SAFE with respect to solvency / phUSD backing (no unbacked phUSD is created, no theft, no drain). The harm is a broken accounting feature / value-tracking leak, not an asset-extraction path; classified Medium on protocol-function-impaired grounds (the feature simply does not work), not on direct asset risk.
attackPath: Owner deploys NudgeRatchet (USDC, 6-dp, deploy-guarded at NudgeRatchet.sol:38) plus NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook and wires the hook.
A dispatch of `amount` USDC flows through onDispatch.
onDispatch computes debt = (amount * ratio) / 100 with no 1e12 scale-up; for 6-dp amount vs 18-dp phUSD this is ~1e12x too small.
The computed debt rounds below the no-op threshold (line 115 guard), so onDispatch records zero phUSD mint-debt.
Net effect: USDC dispatches accrue no phUSD mint-debt; the accounting feature is a silent no-op.
recommendation: Normalize the 6-dp USDC `amount` to 18-dp before applying the ratio, e.g. multiply by 1e12 (or derive the scale factor from the token's decimals at deploy time) so debt = (amount * 1e12 * ratio) / 100. Add a unit test asserting non-zero, correctly-scaled mint-debt for representative USDC amounts.

latentHazard.note: The current bug is an UNDER-mint (fails safe). Any fix that over-corrects past the 1e12 factor flips the sign to an unbacked phUSD OVER-mint — DEDUP-001 / Law-1 solvency territory. The eventual fix MUST be re-audited to confirm the scale factor is exactly 1e12 (USDC 6-dp -> phUSD 18-dp) and not larger, and that no unbacked phUSD can be minted.

corroboratingSources: BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook (18-dp USDS sibling, source of the copied formula)
